summary: Prudential plc furnished a Form 6-K carrying its Q3 2026 business performance update, not a transaction announcement. Q3 new business profit was $709 million, up 1% on a constant-currency basis, with nine-month NBP of $2,093 million, up 6%, and new business margin up 3 percentage points year to date on repricing. Ex-Chinese Mainland life operations, Q3 NBP grew 13%. Management flagged the full-year double-digit growth guidance as more stretching given slower Mainland momentum. No special-situation mechanics, pricing, board recommendation, or advisor is present; watch execution risk against FY26 targets.
